ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……喂，别用这种奇怪的语气说出来啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……抱歉。我刚刚在打电话

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
没什么。……我们快出发吧。
不然摩卡喜欢的面包房要关门了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……嘿嘿哦还是算了吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 摩卡。之前不太顺的乐句，我想合一下音

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那就从再往前两个乐句开始……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……都说了，这个是……！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不要老是对我指手画脚

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……都说了！我都说了没关系！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 没事。练太久累了而已

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不要管我。跟爸爸你没关系吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……烦死了！我回房间了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你好烦啊。
话说，为什么要两人一起练习？真是难得啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 这个……还完全没成型，不能给你看

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 是是是，或许吧。开始练习吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 没关系。是爸爸打来的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 去录音棚了。你们呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 少女乐队演奏会寄来演出通知，是真的吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 对着那个护身符许愿也没有意义吧……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
就算活动内容以及会场和平时不一样，
但我们也只需要『和平时一样』演奏就可以了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
鸫，你是不是累了？
改天也可以讨论的，今天就先……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……那就好。
关于演出的歌曲，第二首和第三首……
